# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a strong bullish EMA ribbon alignment (8>21>55), price often finds support at VWAP during intraday pullbacks, presenting a low-risk long entry when accompanied by bullish candle formation and above-average volume. This setup captures the resumption of the intraday trend with defined risk, leveraging the confluence of trend-following ribbon alignment and mean-reversion to VWAP.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the 8-, 21-, and 55-period EMA ribbon is bullish (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55) for at least three consecutive 5-minute bars, and price pulls back to touch or cross below VWAP (close <= VWAP) while forming a bullish candle (close > open) with volume >= 1.5 × the 20-period average volume, enter long at the close of that bar. Exit: Initial stop at the lowest low of the pullback bar (chart-stop); TP1 at 1.5× risk; runner trailed by a chandelier exit (ATR×3) or exit when the ribbon turns bearish (EMA8 < EMA21). Regime filters: Avoid high-VIX (>20) and restrict to regular market hours (09:45-11:30 EST) when intraday trends are most stable.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account equals ~14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and minimum 3-contract structure.
2. **Sample bias:** Proposal based on conceptual price action principles; zero historical backtest performed. High overfit risk due to untested parameters (ribbon length, volume multiplier, VWAP definition) and regime filters.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic bid/ask/slippage simulation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw during sideways market (multiple false VWAP touches with failing bullish candles); max drawdown scenario: consecutive losing pullbacks in strong downtrend (ribbon remains bullish but price fails to rebound); blow-up scenario: volatility expansion causing VWAP to diverge rapidly from price while ribbon alignment persists, triggering multiple stopped-out entries.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (cannot estimate concentration without historical performance data).
